title: OLEANDER Interior Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic interior-design development from strategic appointment and briefing through concept, spatial and technical design, procurement/construction administration, handover and post-occupancy evaluation while preserving human-use, material/product, FF&E, procurement and cross-disciplinary responsibility boundaries.
scope_in: interior spatial experience and room planning
partitions, ceilings, floors, wall systems and finishes
fixed joinery and custom interior elements
mockups, specialist submittals and construction administration
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project appointment and applicable jurisdiction/professional authority.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires professional interior spatial, material, FF&E, technical, procurement, construction or in-use judgment.
responsibility_triggers: interior design decision controls another discipline or procurement package
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable current claim ceiling across appointment scope, mounted knowledge/product evidence, interface maturity, native interior evidence, mockup/site evidence and external statutory/professional authority governs.
not_triggered_when: decorative reference imagery with explicit exclusion of professional interior-design claims
mandatory_reopen_triggers: site nonconformity or field dimension change
post-occupancy evidence materially contradicts design assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential user, material/product, accessibility, fire, lighting, acoustic, MEP, procurement and field evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional interior decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER design-quality and material/product routing
source_routes: BIID guidance on RIBA Plan of Work and Interior Designers
current applicable interior material/product and building requirements
standard_code_routes: jurisdiction-specific interior, accessibility, fire, material, health and safety requirements
precedent_case_routes: bounded interior precedents where applicability is established
tool_knowledge_routes: current CAD/BIM, schedule, material and visualization execution guidance when used

stages.professional_question: What interior scope, reuse constraints, appointment and procurement responsibilities materially affect the strategic project decision?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential existing-condition, appointment and procurement-role sources before making strategic interior claims.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: strategic brief plus interior scope/responsibility record
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when project scope, use or architecture/interior responsibility materially changes.

human_experience_consequences: high-level user/use and interior experience consequences
design_language_consequences: high-level interior identity/character scope where material
technical_consequences: strategic survey, specialist and procurement constraints
content_projection_requirements: show scope, role, assumptions and unresolved evidence
required_readback: read strategic interior scope against actual appointment/existing evidence
stages.independent_review_requirement: Distinct review where consequence, novelty, commercial role or safety/interface risk requires it.

stages.professional_question: Is there a sufficiently complete interior brief, user/activity basis and scope-of-services boundary to begin concept design?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential user, accessibility, fire, material/product and existing-condition evidence at current claim ceiling.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current architectural brief plus Interior Design Brief
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when room/use/occupancy/circulation or responsibility changes.

human_experience_consequences: activity, privacy, inclusion, storage, sensory and operational requirements
design_language_consequences: brief-level interior identity and material-expression requirements
technical_consequences: evidence and interface requirements for concept work
content_projection_requirements: make user/activity/room/interface and procurement assumptions explicit
stages.independent_review_requirement: Review brief completeness and interface assumptions separately from visual concept preference.
exit_conditions: interior brief and responsibility boundary are sufficient for concept comparison

stages.professional_question: Which interior concept credibly resolves user activity, spatial experience, material direction and controlling interfaces?
entry_conditions: current Interior Design Brief and responsibility basis
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential material/product, accessibility/fire and specialist requirements before retaining a concept on professional grounds.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: interior concept plus MEP concept schematics/reserves
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when system concept/service-zone/equipment strategy materially changes.

human_experience_consequences: spatial sequence, scale, privacy, inclusion and sensory character
design_language_consequences: material, colour, light, joinery and FF&E concept language
content_projection_requirements: comparison-first concept rationale with fixed conditions and failure signs
required_readback: plan/section/experience/material readback at actual concept geometry
stages.independent_review_requirement: Concept review must attack human use, interfaces and design quality, not producer preference alone.
exit_conditions: credible interior concept selected with bounded assumptions and controlling interfaces visible

stages.professional_question: Are room geometry, FF&E/equipment, ceiling/service zones and human-use interfaces coordinated enough for other professions to rely on them?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount changed consequential accessibility, fire, product/system and room-use knowledge before coordinated geometry is treated as current.
human_experience_consequences: actual room use, manoeuvre, furniture/equipment and sensory clearances
design_language_consequences: coordinated interior composition and visible-system integration
technical_consequences: room/ceiling/interface geometry suitable for technical development
content_projection_requirements: critical room plans/sections/RCP and human-use readback
required_readback: actual coordinated plans/sections/RCP at critical rooms/interfaces
stages.independent_review_requirement: Spatial/interface review distinct from clash detection and visual review alone.
open_items_allowed: later technical detail outside spatial claim
exit_conditions: in-claim major/critical interior interfaces meet required Integration maturity

stages.professional_question: Is the interior technically resolved at the declared responsibility boundary for specialist production, procurement and construction?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current product/material/compliance/specialist evidence before technical closure.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current fire strategy/authority input plus technical interior design
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when controlling fire strategy/material/door/compartment requirement changes.

human_experience_consequences: technical realization of human clearances, controls, sensory and maintenance needs
technical_consequences: build-ups, details, product/performance requirements and specialist boundaries
stages.independent_review_requirement: Technical/detail/product/interface review appropriate to project risk and appointment.
open_items_allowed: specialist/shop information explicitly assigned to later production
exit_conditions: technical interior design and required reviews close at declared responsibility boundary

stages.professional_question: Do specialist production information, procured items and observed installation preserve approved interior intent and requirements?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current specialist/product/site evidence before accepting submittals, substitutions, samples or field claims.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current specialist/submittal/procurement/sample records plus interior review decisions
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when specialist geometry, product/material identity, sample benchmark or installation method changes.

human_experience_consequences: actual installed clearances, usability and sensory/detail consequences where observed
design_language_consequences: fabricated/installed detail, finish, FF&E and visible-system quality
content_projection_requirements: distinguish approved design, approved sample/mockup, procured item, observed installation and unresolved deviation
required_readback: actual submittals/samples/mockups/site records for claimed scope
stages.professional_review_owner: Interior Design professional owner within appointed administration/site-review scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Site/sample/submittal verification distinct from supplier/installer self-declaration where required.
open_items_allowed: explicit defects/deferred delivery outside current handover claim
exit_conditions: required production/procurement/site review evidence is current and material deviations resolved or held

stages.professional_question: Is the interior handed over with defects, FF&E/product status, maintenance information and unresolved items explicit?
entry_conditions: interior construction/procurement sufficiently complete for handover decision
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current handover/product/warranty/maintenance evidence before closure.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when final installed/product/defect/maintenance information changes.

design_language_consequences: final observed interior benchmark/finish state where documented
content_projection_requirements: co-locate handover status, defects, product identity and maintenance responsibility
required_readback: final observed interior/FF&E state and current handover records
stages.professional_review_owner: Interior Design professional owner with client/FM participation as applicable
stages.independent_review_requirement: Handover/snagging verification distinct from installer self-declaration where required.
open_items_allowed: explicit deferred defects/items with owner and claim boundary
exit_conditions: handover claim supported by current defect/product/maintenance evidence

stages.professional_question: What does actual use reveal about interior usability, sensory performance, durability and operational fit?
entry_conditions: bounded POE/use question and evidence window exist
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current observation/method/context evidence before drawing in-use or causal conclusions.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: actual use/FM/maintenance evidence plus design/handover baseline
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when use, operation, maintenance state or observation evidence materially changes.

human_experience_consequences: actual usability, inclusion, comfort, privacy and sensory outcomes where evidenced
design_language_consequences: actual ageing/wear/adaptation consequences for interior language
content_projection_requirements: separate design intent, observed state, user report, maintenance evidence, uncertainty and causal inference
required_readback: actual use/defect/wear/maintenance evidence for declared POE scope
stages.professional_review_owner: Interior Design professional owner with FM/user/specialist participation as applicable
stages.independent_review_requirement: Distinct POE/evidence review where consequential claims depend on it.
open_items_allowed: future use states outside observation window
exit_conditions: bounded in-use question assessed at current evidence ceiling

interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Resolve actual enter/close maturity per interface binding and Acceptance Contract; interior stage number does not imply interface maturity or synchronization.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: remaining work is explicitly later/outside claim

native_source_of_truth_rules: editable/native interior source remains authoritative over renders/screenshots
sample/product datasheet does not replace assembled-system/room evidence
render does not replace dimensional/detail readback
tool_adapter_requirements: Current Skill Resolver selects current capabilities/tools; no hardcoded global inventory
actual_readback_requirements: actual use evidence for POE claims

assurance.professional_review: Interior professional review at the current stage/claim ceiling, separate from pure visual preference.
assurance.evidence_review: Check user/room, product/material, specialist, procurement, sample/mockup, site and POE evidence against claimed use.
technical_gates: site/handover gate when field claims are made
assurance.independent_review: Required where risk, safety/interface consequence, procurement conflict, complexity or stage demands a distinct reviewer; producer self-check alone does not satisfy independence.
assurance.receipt_contract: Professional receipt records stage/process verdict, claim ceiling, appointment/scope, native/readback refs, product/sample/site evidence, open items and does-not-prove boundary.

stale_scope_rules: invalidate only affected room/detail/product/interface/procurement/site evidence unless dependencies show wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed Architecture/MEP/Fire/Accessibility/Lighting/Acoustic/product evidence propagates to consuming interior stages
downstream_impact_rules: changed room/partition/FF&E/material/detail/procurement variables propagate to consuming professions, suppliers and FM
interface_reopen_rules: reopen affected Integration interfaces when shared variables/acceptance criteria change
receipt_stale_rules: professional receipt becomes stale at affected scope when appointment, native design, product identity, sample benchmark, site or evidence basis changes

process_exit_conditions: all triggered interior stages close at declared current claim ceiling
open items are explicit later/outside claim and non-contradictory
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim specialist, procurement, defect or POE items that do not contradict current professional verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: A current professional PASS may satisfy only the bounded Interior professional-process dependency; it does not grant statutory approval, field validity, Design KEEP or Promotion.
